owner_calls.question: Whose bodies does Danny find at the K'un-Lun pass in Iron Fist S1? The out says dead monks with the Hand's weapons beside them, and loss:0 puts the monks' deaths on Iron Fist S1. The episode summaries say the dead are Hand soldiers; that the Hand killed the monks only comes out later, when Elektra boasts about it in The Defenders.
options: Keep as is (one wiki page says monks' corpses with Hand weapons)
out: 'he finds dead Hand warriors at the mouth of the pass and the way to the city gone'; move loss:0 to The Defenders as 'The monks of K'un-Lun, killed by Elektra and the Hand.'
Change only out, keep loss:0 on Iron Fist S1
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's Iron Fist S1 episode 13 summary: 'they arrive at the gate to find it shut off from the Earth, and surrounded by dead Hand operatives.' Fandom's episode page and its K'un-Lun page: 'the bodies of a few dead Hand ninjas'. But Fandom's Attack on K'un-Lun page: 'he saw the corpses of the Order of the Crane Mother and the Hand weapons near them', and it cites Elektra in The Defenders ('You should've heard the way they screamed when I killed them').
